title: SAS
description: Semiconductor Agnostic Structure (SAS). A document carries inputs, exactly one of {mosfet, diode, igbt, bjt, thyristor, jfet, optocoupler, module} (the field name is the discriminator), and outputs.

inputs.description: Design requirements and operating points for this semiconductor
inputs.title: inputs

diode.description: Diode (Schottky, ultrafast, SiC Schottky, Zener, TVS)
diode.title: diode

thyristor.description: Thyristor: SCR, triac, sidac, diac, thyristor surge protector
thyristor.title: thyristor

jfet.description: Junction FET (n- or p-channel; Si, SiC)
jfet.title: jfet

optocoupler.description: Optocoupler (LED input, photo-detector output, isolation barrier)
optocoupler.title: optocoupler

module.description: Multi-die power module (half-bridge, full-bridge, sixpack, chopper, ...; Si IGBT / Si-SiC MOSFET / GaN HEMT dies)
module.title: module

outputs.description: Computed results per operating point. outputs[i] aligns positionally with inputs.operatingPoints[i].
outputs.title: outputs
